status_reason: Feasibility of separate->combined ACK-mode normalization. Effectiveness measured (trace-transformation); the safe realizable mechanism identified (socket-side coalescing for owned decoy/replay servers; egress immediate-drop only for real-inline). Implementation NOT started; requires explicit authorization.
reprioritizes: the plan's original Phase 05 (comprehensive attacker eval was already done in Phase 04)

effectiveness_balanced_accuracy.note: trace-transformation; baseline majority-class 0.400 / uniform 0.333; ack-mode/timing/size feature space only

key_findings: Suppression closes the ACK-mode channel timing normalization could not: ack_only 0.759->0.482 (mode only); suppress+timing reaches the size-only floor (all 0.501 ~ oracle 0.500).

Residual after mode+timing normalization is response SIZE (out of scope; separate padding line). Static TCP headers (TTL 64 / window 29200 / MSS 1460 / wscale 7) are IDENTICAL across the 3 devices -> p0f static fingerprinting does not distinguish them; the eval feature space is the relevant one.

SAFE design (hold-then-decide) is architecturally IMPOSSIBLE as a tc-egress DROP (can't cancel a queued skb; ACK egresses before the response). Only immediate predictive TC_ACT_SHOT is realizable inline -- irreversible, proactive fail-open only, irreducible slow-transaction residual.

The safe hold-then-decide behaviour IS realizable as SOCKET-SIDE COALESCING where we own the socket (no quickack + response within the delayed-ACK window -> kernel piggybacks the ACK). Zero drops, perfect fail-safety, byte-preserving, no BPF. Already WIRE-DEMONSTRATED in Phase 03 (fixed25/bounded full stay COMBINED).

Suppression DROP is Tofino-NATIVE (mark_to_drop, line-rate) -- the inverse of the Tofino-hostile EDT hold; the more portable half. bpf_timer incompatible with the legacy bpf_elf_map loader -> in-band retransmit disarm.

recommended_mechanism.decoy_replay_we_own: socket-side coalescing (no quickack + response within delayed-ACK window) -- primary, perfectly fail-safe, no drops
recommended_mechanism.inline_real_device: egress immediate predictive TC_ACT_SHOT with mandatory proactive gating + in-band disarm -- secondary, irreversible, riskier

residual_out_of_scope: response size (padding primitive, separate line); piggyback-ACK timing distribution shape; possible TCP-timestamp clock-skew

coalescing_defended_wire_demo.tool: phase05_coalescing_demo.py (sg wireshark; no sudo, no BPF, no netns)
coalescing_defended_wire_demo.result: On the actual wire, socket coalescing (no quickack + response within the delayed-ACK window) flips the request ACK mode from separate to combined: undefended_separate 80/80 separate -> defended_coalesced 0/80 separate; 200/200 byte-identical; 0 retransmissions/resets. The residual 40 server pure ACKs in the defended capture are handshake + CONFIRM-ACKs (non-discriminating; is_separate keys on the request-ACK, which is normalized).
coalescing_defended_wire_demo.validates: the mechanism on the wire (is_separate->0 achievable byte-preservingly, no drops) -- anchoring the trace-transformation effectiveness result; per-device defended-wire classifier eval needs a rig (deferred).

recommended_next_phase: per-device defended-wire classifier eval needs a multi-device rig (deferred); or the Tofino-native drop path for real-inline; or the separate size-padding line
